item_reroll:Name: Restring
item_reroll:Result: the magic item with ALL its mods rerolled; base and level stay
item_reroll:Makes: the magic item, ALL mods rolled new (can be worse)
item_ascend:Name: Base Ascension
item_ascend:Recipe: any gear + 1 rune of Tier III or higher + 2 jewels of any colour, each Cut, Faceted or Radiant
item_ascend:Result: the same item on the next base of its kind (same defence type, never lower); mods and sockets stay
item_ascend:Makes: the same item on the next base of its kind (same defence type, never lower)
item_ascend:Keeps: every mod, item level, sockets, runes, the defence type
item_retemper:Name: Retempering
item_retemper:Recipe: a rare + 2 Tier II+ runes + a jewel of Cut or finer
item_retemper:Result: the rare with ALL its mods rerolled at this rupture's level (only above the item's level)
item_retemper:Makes: the rare, ALL mods rolled new at this rupture's level
item_retemper:UsesUp: 2 runes, the jewel + every old mod
item_runebase:Name: Runesmith's Base
item_runebase:Recipe: a plain white weapon or armour (ML 30+) + 3 identical Tier I runes
item_runebase:Result: the same white base with its most sockets
item_runebase:Makes: the same white base with its most sockets
item_runebase:Keeps: the base and its item level
red_ascent:Name: Red Ascent
red_ascent:Result: 1 random red of the next tier (the 3 reds are used up)
red_ascent:Makes: 1 random red of the next tier
red_ascent:Keeps: nothing - only the new red comes out
red_turning:Name: Red Turning
red_turning:Recipe: 2 reds of one tier + any rune
red_turning:Result: 1 random other red of the same tier (the reds and the rune are used up)
red_turning:Makes: 1 random OTHER red of the same tier
red_descent:Name: Red Descent
red_descent:Recipe: a red of Tier II to IV + any rune
red_descent:Result: 1 random red of the tier below it (the red and the rune are used up)
red_descent:Makes: 1 random red of the tier below
red_descent:Keeps: nothing - only the new red comes out
red_reroll:Name: Red Reawakening
red_reroll:Recipe: a red + 2 jewels of Cut or finer
red_reroll:Result: the same red, its values rerolled inside their ranges (can roll lower); tier stays. Reds with fixed values are refused
red_reroll:Makes: the same red, its values rolled again (can roll lower)
red_reroll:Keeps: the red, its tier, item level, fixed lines (values that never reroll)
red_retemper:Name: Red Retempering
red_retemper:Recipe: a red + a Tier IV+ rune + a Faceted or Radiant jewel
red_retemper:Result: the same red, its values rerolled in their ranges and its item level raised (values never grow with level). Reds with fixed values are refused
red_retemper:Makes: the same red at this rupture's level, values rolled again
red_retemper:Keeps: the red, its tier, fixed lines (values that never reroll)
red_unmake:Name: Red Unmaking
red_unmake:Result: 2 random jewels, finer for a higher tier (the red is destroyed)
red_unmake:Makes: 2 random jewels, finer for a higher red tier
red_echo:Name: The Perfect Echo
red_echo:Recipe: two copies of the same red
red_echo:Result: one red with every value at its best (the other copy is used up)
red_echo:Makes: 1 copy of the red with every value at its best
red_vow_mark:Name: Vowbinding: the Mark
red_vow_mark:Recipe: a red + a Marked base of the same kind + a Tier V+ rune
red_vow_mark:Result: the same red on the Marked base: every red value kept, the Mark becomes its implicit, the higher item level
red_vow_mark:Makes: the red on the Marked base, the Mark its implicit
red_vow_mark:UsesUp: the red's old base, the Marked item's own mods, the rune
red_vow_mark:Keeps: every red value, sockets, runes, the higher item level
red_vow_take:Name: Vowbinding: a Vow
red_vow_take:Recipe: a red + a rare of the same slot + a Tier V+ rune (the first Vow; then 1, 2, 3... red runes)
red_vow_take:Result: the same red with the rare's finest mod (best tier first) as a Vow; a Vow of the same kind is replaced
red_vow_take:Makes: the red + 1 Vow: the rare's finest mod
red_vow_take:UsesUp: the rare and the runes (Tier V+ for the first Vow, then 1, 2, 3... red runes)
red_vow_take:Keeps: every red value, base, Mark, the other Vows
sigil_binding:Name: Sigil Binding
sigil_binding:Recipe: 3 Tier III or IV sigils + 1 red rune
sigil_binding:Result: 1 Unique Sigil in your pouch: a reward past the cap and a crimson penalty (the sigils are used up)
sigil_binding:Makes: 1 Unique Sigil: wealth sigils make the Hoardking, horde and champions the Endless Muster, augury and omens the Broken Seer
sigil_binding:UsesUp: the 3 sigils and the red rune
sigil_binding:Keeps: nothing, only the Unique Sigil comes out (into your pouch)
idol_merge:Name: Idol Merging
idol_merge:Result: 1 idol of 3 cells (1x3 or 3x1); it keeps the FIRST idol's first line at the bigger size (value rolled again in its tier), its other line is new (the 3 idols and the jewel are used up)
idol_merge:Makes: 1 idol of 3 cells, its 2nd line new
idol_merge:Keeps: the FIRST idol's first line (value rerolled in its tier)
idol_fuse:Name: Idol Fusing
idol_fuse:Recipe: 3 magic 2-cell idols + a jewel of Cut or finer
idol_fuse:Result: 1 idol of 4 cells (1x4 or 4x1); it keeps the FIRST idol's first line at the bigger size (value rolled again in its tier), its other line is new (the 3 idols and the jewel are used up)
idol_fuse:Makes: 1 idol of 4 cells, its 2nd line new
idol_fuse:Keeps: the FIRST idol's first line (value rerolled in its tier)
item_blank_slate:Name: Blank Slate
item_blank_slate:Recipe: a magic or rare weapon, body armour, helmet or shield + 2 Tier II+ runes
item_blank_slate:Result: the same base as a plain white, its item level, Mark, Quality and sockets kept (every mod is used up)
item_blank_slate:Makes: the same base, white: an Oathword base
item_blank_slate:Keeps: base and Mark, item level, Quality, sockets
rare_oathsworn:Name: Oathsworn
rare_oathsworn:Recipe: a rare + a Tier V+ rune + 3 Core Embers (from your Forge store)
rare_oathsworn:Result: the same rare with one more line, its Oathsworn line: rolled from its own pool at the best tier its item level allows (a full rare holds 7 lines); a Vow can never take it
rare_oathsworn:Makes: the rare + its Oathsworn line (one more line, at its best tier)
rare_oathsworn:UsesUp: the rune and 3 Core Embers (a held Oathsworn line rolls again)
rare_oathsworn:Keeps: every line, its base, its sockets
idol_temper:Name: Idol Tempering
idol_temper:Recipe: a magic or rare idol + 1 Tier III or IV rune
idol_temper:Result: the same idol: every line keeps its kind, its tier and value are rolled again within the idol's item level (it can be worse)
idol_temper:Makes: the idol, every line's tier rolled again
idol_temper:Keeps: every line's kind, its size, its item level
item_resist_turn:Name: Resist Turning
item_resist_turn:Recipe: an item with a resistance line + 1 Tier I to IV rune + 1 Core Ember (from your Forge store)
item_resist_turn:Result: its first resistance line turns to the next element it lacks (Fire, Cold, Lightning, Poison), same tier, same roll
item_resist_turn:Makes: 1st resistance: the next element it lacks
item_resist_turn:Keeps: that line's tier and roll, every other line
